faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.description: Straight answers about timelines, pricing, and how we work.

timeline.q: How long does a typical project take?
timeline.a: A simple marketing site usually ships in 2–4 weeks. Multi-page or custom apps take longer depending on scope — we'll give you a clear timeline before we start.

pricing.q: What's included in the listed packages?
pricing.a: Each package lists its features above. Custom work is scoped after a short discovery call so pricing matches your goals, not a one-size template.

maintenance.a: Yes. Monthly care plans cover hosting, SSL, updates, monitoring, and small content changes so your site stays secure and current.

hosting.q: Where will my site be hosted?
hosting.a: We provide managed hosting with SSL by default. If you already have a preferred host, we can deploy there too.

revisions.q: How many design revisions do I get?
revisions.a: Packages include structured review rounds. We'll align on a clear revision policy in your proposal so expectations stay honest.

languages.a: Absolutely. We've shipped Spanish/English experiences (like Santiso) and can add more locales as needed.
